Round cleanup passes claude-review/* branch names to remove_agent_worktrees.sh, whose only target arm accepts claude/* | claude-routines/*, so every lane/refuter/station worktree and branch is left behind.
The casual-audience SMINE_AUTO_APPLY=decide default never fires on a launchd run: run.sh defaults to decide only when the variable is empty, but the plist template install.sh copies pins it to never.

handleWelcomeBootstrap writes the multi-hour bootstrap child's output to os.TempDir()/smine-bootstrap.log and never logs the pid, while spec-5 requires a log under the routine logs dir plus a logged pid.

The new permissions kind (step 4 appends the proposal's rule to permissions.allow) is reachable from step 5 auto-apply, whose candidate set in always mode with no dimensions is every proposed entry, so allow rules can widen without a vote.

The policy base is resolved from the working (branch-editable) policy's base_ref, so an agent branch can pick its own base (base_ref=HEAD or an unresolvable ref plus mode free) and neuter the gated/strict gate.
GitChangedFiles uses git diff --name-only with default rename detection, so a renamed-away declaration file reports only its new path and ruleDelta never sees the removed base-side rules.

The orchestrate-stage reconcile copies every repos.json path into ~/.claude/settings.json additionalDirectories with no record of whether the operator granted access, so a repo added with the grant unticked is granted on the next nightly.
surfaceDelta compares raw working-tree bytes to git show blob bytes, so on a CRLF checkout (core.autocrlf=true) unchanged policy surface files are reported as changed.

The diff deletes the four permissions.ask rules for Edit/Write on *.acdsl and acdsl/** from the deployed settings template; no spec asks for it and the policy guard exits 0 in free mode, so nothing replaces the confirmation.

handleProfileSave persists the new audience before taking the skills-sync lock and decides whether to sync by comparing against the stored audience, so a retry after a 409 or a failed skills.Sync skips the sync.
handleReposAdd runs git init -b main on a plain folder before the registry's duplicate-name rejection, so a rejected duplicate add still mutates the folder.

Moving the worktree-table kind/base filter client-side made the header select-all checkbox (and any row checked before a filter change) select rows the active filter hides, so Remove / Remove Worktree acts on worktrees and branches the user filtered out of view. At base the filter was server-side (rows outside the filter were never rendered), so select-all could only ever pick visible rows.

The shell consumers parse the presentation profile with sed and compare to the literal casual without stripping a trailing CR; .gitattributes does not pin settings/claude_code/presentation-profile.de.md, so a Windows/CRLF checkout yields audience 'casual\r' and sync_skills.sh takes the developer branch, while smine-nightly/run.sh never applies the casual defaults and passes 'language de\r' to consolidate.

Step 3 promises a rule parked in settings.disabled.json never resurfaces, but reads it as the sibling of settings/claude_code/settings.json, which never exists; the config server parks rules in config.DisabledPath(~/.claude/settings.json) = ~/.claude/settings.disabled.json, so a parked rule granted again in later sessions is re-proposed.

On a casual install the step-4 casual lockout only sets disposition casual-locked; the proposal stays proposed with no autoApplyHeld, so step-5 auto-apply re-picks it every night, filling cap slots before the lockout fires and re-ledgering it each run; smine-skills never drops pre-existing locked entries and smine-consolidate can re-home them.
